subject.title: fix(hooks): wire message:sending internal hook to user-defined hooks

question: Should user-defined `message:sending` be a post-policy read-only notification of the final deliverable content, or a pre-policy event that may expose content later rewritten or canceled?
rationale: The event position determines the content-filtering and audit security contract; code mechanics cannot safely choose that permanent hook semantic without owner intent.

options.title: Post-policy notification
options.body: Emit exactly once after plugin modification or cancellation, using final content and skipping canceled deliveries.

options.title: Pre-policy notification
options.body: Keep the event before policy processing and explicitly document that it observes attempted, unfiltered content including canceled sends.

recommendation.title: Post-policy notification
recommendation.body: Emit exactly once after plugin modification or cancellation, using final content and skipping canceled deliveries.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current exactly-once message-sending work owns the overlapping delivery-order contract across channel paths.
